STAGAS.description: Save Stage As (STAGAS). Exports the model at a specified construction stage to a new file; the fields specify the export file path and the target stage step.

Argument.description: Request payload driving the save-stage-as operation.

EXPORT_PATH.description: Full export file path including file name and extension. Must be non-empty and use a supported extension (.mgb/.mgbx for GEN, .mcb for CIVIL). The parent folder is created automatically if it does not exist.

STAGE_STEP.description: Name of the construction stage step to export. In post-processing mode the special names 'PostCS' (final stage) and 'Min/Max' are also accepted. Must resolve to a valid stage; otherwise the request fails.
